name: Warhead Junction
theme: Collect Nuclear Warheads across the map and call down tactical strikes on enemy structures and Heroes.
firstObjective: Warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00 (~2:30 cooldown after the final Warhead of a wave is collected)
spawnPattern: Multiple Warheads spawn simultaneously across set map nodes (typically 2 to 4 per wave, scaling up over the match)

mechanic.title: Nuclear Warheads
mechanic.description: Channel an active Nuclear Warhead to claim it as an objective ability—Heroes can carry a Warhead and drop it on death, where it can be picked up by either team. Activating a Warhead calls down a delayed strike on a target area that deals heavy structure damage and high damage in the center blast radius, though enemies can walk out of the inner zone or interrupt/cancel launches if caught.

camps.name: Hellbat / Bruiser Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper-mid and lower-mid areas. Hellbats breathe cone fire that shreds minion waves and reduces enemy Armor.

camps.name: Goliath / Raven Siege Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the outer top and bottom jungle paths. Features ranged Goliaths paired with a Raven that launches seeker missiles at structures.

camps.name: Swarm Host Bosses (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top-center and bottom-center pits. Spawns Locusts and drops toxic pods; applies heavy lane pressure and can be captured to push lanes.

strategy: Warhead Junction is a large three-lane battleground where cross-map distance, split rotations, and Warhead coordination heavily shape macro play. Heroes with global mobility (such as Falstad, Dehaka, or Brightwing) and strong solo/offlaners shine across wide rotations; stack multiple Warheads onto a single Keep or Core push when possible rather than firing isolated nukes for low value.
notes: Vents/tunnels allow quick cross-map movement between top and bottom areas—watch for rotations through them, and remember that carrying multiple Warheads puts high value on not dying carelessly before you can launch or coordinate them.
